logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient (log D) was determined using the traditional shakeflask method using octanol-10 mM phosphate buffer solution containing 4 mM NaCl (pH=7.4). After pre-equilibration of octanol and aqueous phosphate buffer solutions (2 mL each) overnight, 1– 9 (1 mg each) were added and shaken continuously (150 rpm) at 37°C for 6 h on a BOD incubator. The tubes were then centrifuged, and aliquots of the octanol and aqueous buffer layers were pipetted out separately. Absorbances were measured, with necessary dilutions, by means of UV-Visible spectroscopy. Each set was performed in triplicate. Concentration in each layer was determined from the respective molar extinction coefficient values and the corresponding distribution coefficient (log D) was calculated.
